name: AI Vendor Claim Reality-Check Procurement Packet
use_case: AI vendor claim review before software, automation, agent, model-platform, implementation or managed-service spend
safe_inputs: public vendor claim or proposal excerpt
redacted screenshots if approved by the owner
claim_boundaries: no legal, privacy, security, procurement or compliance advice
no revenue, savings, ROI, demand, lead, customer outcome or AI-accuracy claim
no assertion that a vendor is safe, compliant or unsuitable without adviser review
